title.narrative: DKT - Social marketing of SRH Commodities 2023-2026
DKT - Social marknadsföring av SRH produkter 2023-2026

description.narrative:
Programmet Strengthening Reproductive Health and Rights in Africa: Scaling Up Access to Contraception and Safe Abortion (2023- 2026) syftar att öka utbud av och tillgång till högkvalitativa preventivmedel och produkter för medicinsk abort i Afrika söder om Sahara.
Det övergripande målet av insatsen är att bidra till framsteg mot universell sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa genom att leverera 29 037 864 Couple Years of Protection (CYP) mellan april 2023 och december 2026, och förhindra uppskattningsvis 5 056 214 oönskade graviditeter, 42 347 mödradödsfall och 8 057 656 osäkra aborter i Afrika söder om Sahara.
DKT kommer att uppnå detta via tre (delvis nya) delmål; 1: Förstärkt distributionskedja genom att öka tillgången till moderna preventivmetoder och säker abort 2: Utökad tillgång till SRH-information och tjänster 3: Förbättrad kvalitet på SRH-vården genom kapacitetsuppbyggnad
Geografiskt fokus; Fransktalande Väst- och Centralafrika (FWACA): Benin, Burkina Faso, Kamerun, Tchad, Elfenbenskusten, Gabon, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau (portugisisktalande), Mali, Mauretanien, Niger, Senegal och Togo.
Engelsktalande Västafrika (AWA): Liberia, Sierra Leone, Gambia och Ghana Landprogram: DR Kongo (DRC) och Moçambique (stöd till DKT landskontor istället för DKT:s regionala program)
Förutom det regionala SRHR teamet kommer ambassaderna i Kinshasa och Bamako att bidra till programmet (genom att direkt finansiera programverksamheten i DR Kongo och Mali).

The Strengthening Reproductive Health and Rights in Africa: Scaling Up Access to Contraception and Safe Abortion (2023 - 2026) programme's aim is to increase the availability, accessibility, affordability and supply of high quality contraceptives and medical abortion products in Sub-Saharan Africa.
The overall objective of the intervention is to contribute to progress towards universal sexual and reproductive health and rights by generating 29,037,864 Couple Years of Protection (CYPs) between April 2023-December 2026, contributing to an estimated 5,056,214 unintended pregnancies averted, 42,347 maternal deaths averted, and 8,057,656 unsafe abortions averted. DKT has identfied three outcomes in its theory of change to achieve these results:
1: Strengthened supply chain by increasing availability of modern contraceptive methods and safe abortion 2: Expanded access to SRH information and services 3: Improved quality of SRH care through capacity building
The following countries will be included in the programme through a mix of regional and country programmes:
1. Francophone West and Central Africa (FWACA): Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Gabon, Guinea, Guinea Bissau (Portuguese-speaking), Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Senegal and Togo.
2. Anglophone West Africa (AWA): Liberia, Sierra Leone, Gambia and Ghana.
3. Country programmes: DR Congo (DRC) and Mozambique
In addition to the Regional SRHR team, the embassies in Kinshasa and Bamako will contribute to the programme (directly funding the programme activities in DRC and Mali).

The overall impact of the intervention is to contribute to progress towards universal sexual and reproductive health and rights by generating 29 million Couple Years of Protection (CYPs), averting 5 million unintended pregnancies, 42,300 maternal deaths, and 8.1 million unsafe abortions across sub-Saharan Africa over the four-year time period.
Outcome 1: Strengthened supply chain by increasing availability of modern contraceptive methods and safe abortion
Output 1.1: Increased sales of contraception and safe abortion products
Output 1.2: Register new SRH products
Output 1.3: Leveraged regional approaches and economies of scale
Output 1.4: Monitoring and follow-up on implementation of global policies
Outcome 2: Expanded access to SRH information and services
Output 2.1: Employ gender-sensitive marketing strategies to increase awareness and demand for SRH
Output 2.2: Improve SRH access in underserved communities
Output 2.3: Connect end-users to SRH care
Output 2.4: Leverage technology to increase access to SRH information and services
Outcome 3: Improved quality of SRH care through capacity building
Output 3.1: Train/detail providers and dispensers in both the private and public sector on provision of full product range and counselling

Overall, DKTs efforts in 2024 resulted in the generation of over 6 million couple years of protection (CYPs) through strong product sales. The organization distributed 77 million condoms, 3.5 million oral contraceptives (OCs), and 10.4 million emergency contraceptives (ECs), among other essential SRH products. By strengthening public private partnerships and embracing digital innovations, DKT continued to build sustainable and inclusive reproductive health markets. DKT also strengthened its commitment to ensuring LGBTQ individuals have access to judgement free SRH services. In several countries, DKT worked discreetly with local organizations to provide LGBTQ individuals with access to inclusive sexual health education and contraception.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
